plaintextml is a newer and comprehensive AI and ML news aggregator with news, research, blogs, industry, podcasts, videos, and  community (extracts from social media) sections.  It is one of the better, more comprehensive websites of this type and has the advantage that its web page layout is more compact as the stories just have weblinked titles instead of being accompanied by AI generated images taking up a lot of screen space.

https://www.plaintextml.com
